GET /users/registered.reason: Answers only a Coworker or Soko Bot key; an MCP caller is a person.

GET /users/{id}/deletion.reason: Account lifecycle: a person deletes their account in the web app.

DELETE /users/{id}/oauth-consents/{conse.reason: Credential management: revoking an OAuth client's tokens stays in the browser.

GET /users/{id}/sessions.reason: Interactive browser session only: sessions are credentials.

DELETE /users/{id}/sessions/{sessionId}.reason: Interactive browser session only: sessions are credentials.

GET /users/{id}/notices/pending.reason: Account lifecycle: notices such as updated legal terms are for the person to read and accept in the web app.

POST /users/{id}/notices/{noticeId}/ackn.reason: Account lifecycle: acknowledging a notice, such as updated legal terms, is the person's acceptance.

GET /users/{id}/badge-campaigns.reason: Web app UI only: the New badges the app shows the person.

POST /users/{id}/badge-campaigns/{campai.reason: Web app UI only: records that the person opened a feature with a New badge.

POST /users/{id}/files.reason: The upload ends with an HTTP PUT of the file bytes to Blob storage, which an MCP client cannot send.

POST /users/{id}/utm-attribution.reason: Onboarding: sign-up attribution the web app records.

POST /users/{id}/sign-up-conversion.reason: Onboarding: the sign-up page claims it, in an interactive session only.

GET /users/{id}/sign-up.reason: Onboarding: the sign-up origin the web app records.

POST /users/{id}/coworker-access/{access.reason: Granting a Coworker access to a workspace is the person's decision; an agent could approve its own request.

POST /users/{id}/vendor-grants.reason: Granting a vendor access to a workspace is the person's decision; an agent could approve its own vendor.

POST /users/{id}/vendor-grants/{grantId}.reason: Granting a vendor access to a workspace is the person's decision; an agent could approve its own vendor.

GET /users/{id}/stripe-customer.reason: Billing: a person manages payment details and plans in the web app.

POST /users/{id}/stripe-customer.reason: Billing: a person manages payment details and plans in the web app.

GET /users/{id}/billing-details.reason: Billing: a person manages payment details and plans in the web app.

GET /users/{id}/subscription.reason: Billing: a person manages payment details and plans in the web app.
